title: Let the Beloved's way please you
summary: This meets the moment when the heart keeps arguing with what has already arrived. The line turns acceptance into affection instead of grim resignation.
takeaway: Receive the Beloved's doing without inner protest.
lifeApplication: When the day turns against your plan, catch the complaint in the throat. Say the line once before you retell the event as injury.

source.shortMeaning: The heart stops arguing and learns to cherish the Beloved's way.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next complaint, soften the mouth and receive this turn from the Beloved.

evidence.coreClaim: The heart stops arguing and learns to cherish the Beloved's way.
evidence.turn: Let the Beloved's way grow dearer than the mind's protest.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the day turns against your plan, catch the complaint in the throat. Say the line once before you retell the event as injury.
